title: code.read should report whether returned text was truncated
wanted_capability: code.read results should include explicit returned byte/char counts and a truncated boolean so agents can distinguish actual source text from display truncation and avoid redundant file_read calls.
fallback_used: Probe used an extra file_read to verify exact source text before extraction.
resolution_note: Addressed by adding byte_length, char_length, and truncated=false metadata to successful code.read results and updating namespace declarations.
